# Strength of a Warrior

*Tobin says a warrior is measured by more than errands. Reach level 5 and use Power Strike five times. He will teach you Warrior's Resolve.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Tobin](../npcs/tobin.md) |
| Level | 3 |
| After | [Shells for the Mayor](../quests/shells_for_the_mayor.md) |

## Objectives

- Reach level 5
- Use [Power Strike](../skills/warrior.md#power-strike) 5 times

## Rewards

- 200 EXP
- [Bronze Helmet](../items/bronze_helmet.md) x1
- Skill: [Warrior's Resolve](../skills/buffs.md#warriors-resolve)
- +20 standing with Kaldemor
